chunks: As for whatever is in it from Hārūn ibn Khārijah, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allah, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Kūfī, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Hārūn ibn Khārijah al-Kūfī.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, from whom the author narrates
key_terms.الْكُوفِيِّ: of Kūfah; identifying the narrator’s attribution
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: one of the transmitters in the chain
key_terms.هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ: the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Hārūn ibn Khārijah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Hārūn ibn Khārijah al-Kūfī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and identifying the intermediaries through whom the narration was received.
